title: Add a password-reset feature
intent: Add a password reset feature. Create appropriate tests and make sure existing authentication functionality is not affected.
acceptance_criteria: User can request a password-reset token
Reset tokens expire after a fixed TTL
Invalid or already-used reset tokens are rejected
expected_risks: Reset tokens stored in-memory are lost on process restart
Token delivery (e.g. email) is out of scope
expected_failure_modes: Reset token used after TTL expiry
